about_the_game:
• Eight forgotten machines - Awaken as Katame and discover your siblings, each with a distinct personality, combat style, and way of seeing the world.

  • B.O.B. the guide - Your best and closest friend in a lonely world. A luminous presence that leads and guides you, shifting form to uncover hidden paths, subterranean tunnels, metros, ShellMothers, or sibling robots.

  • Guided without maps — no world map, no GPS. Observe the world around you: herds of worker robots, shifting signs, and derelict terminals that awaken when powered. Trust in B.O.B.’s flicker to lead you — or get lost in the unknown.

  • Scraps and salvage - Fragments scattered across the world or torn from defeated machines. Collect them to alter weapons, craft armor, or to carry a look all your own.

  • Dungeons of flesh and iron - Organ-like tunnels where blood can be siphoned, unstable androids linger, and memories resurface in hallucinatory glimpses. Awaken dormant Conductors through risky harvesting or combat; risk exposure, and the dungeon will rise against you.

  • Ouroboros Chymes - Feed the machine your scraps to fuel the power grid. Everything is connected.

  • Colossal ShellMothers - Giants bound to a failed cycle and keepers of the keys to the G.O.D. Facility, to be confronted or negotiated with.

  • A living ecosystem - Nearly a million robots: workers, drones, Custodians, and the mysterious Conductors maintain balance. Every choice leaves a trace: restore what is broken — or unravel it further.

  • A world reclaimed - Eight handcrafted biomes with dynamic day/night, weather, and seasons, haunted by corporate ruins, decayed bunkers, and colossal remains.

Welcome to Endless Machines, a vast and ever-changing world—reclaimed by nature and maintained by robots, from lush forests and windswept plains to arctic tundra and fuming swamps.

Far into the future, eight robots — once built for war and destruction — awaken in a world they no longer recognize, far removed from their original purpose. Discarded and forgotten, they set out to piece together the fragments of their past in search of their creators. Why were they abandoned?

It’s a journey through danger, wonder, and unexpected revelations. Will your choices come back to haunt you — or will they reward you? How will you shape the landscapes you traverse? What path will you forge in this vibrant yet lonely world?

And what truths will you uncover on your journey?

This is a story of self-discovery — of searching for what was, and forging what comes next. As a creator or a destroyer, you’ll shape the world around you through every choice you make.

Wishlist now and prepare to awaken!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Winows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel / AMD 2.5 GHz or superior
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core 17 10th gen / AMD Ryzen 9 5950x
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 14 GB available space

short_description: Search for your past and forge your future—as a creator or destroyer—eight lonely robots on a journey of exploration, self-discovery, danger, wonders and unexpected revelations, in this richly detailed and carefully crafted top-down, open-world ARPG.
